# Efficient_Coding_Constraint

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A constraint that minimizes redundancy and maximizes information per spike or resource unit, shaping neural dynamics and connectivity. Guides the design of energy-efficient in-network neuromorphic processors that process data with minimal bandwidth and power.
